entities.summary: The proclamation An Mein Volk was issued by King Frederick William III of Prussia on 17 March 1813 in Breslau. Addressed to his subjects, Preußen und Deutsche, it appealed for their support in the struggle against Napoleon. Hostilities had been declared the day before.
